summary: CTW, a Tokyo-based Nasdaq-listed game platform operator (G123.jp), filed a Form 6-K solely to correct a typographical error in the venue address of its annual general meeting. The prior November 9, 2026 filing misstated the address as 2-8-17 Shiba; the correct address is 2-7-17 Shiba, Minato-ku, Tokyo. A revised press release, notice of AGM and form of proxy were furnished. The meeting date, time, agenda and all other arrangements are unchanged. No special-situation event; no deal terms. Watch merely for routine shareholder meeting outcomes.
